verdict.rationale: 1Password's own docs show it creates, saves and signs in with passkeys through its browser extension, so passkeys live in the 1Password vault rather than a platform vendor's keychain. However, the evidence never states that passkeys sync across iOS, Android, Windows, Linux and multiple browsers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-device/cross-OS passkey sync, per-platform passkey support (iOS, Android, Windows, Linux), independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-ecosystem passkey use.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor

citations.quote: you can now create, manage, and sign in with passkeys on a growing number of websites and apps directly from the 1Password browser extension
You can use 1Password to save the passkeys you create for your accounts and sign in to websites with passkeys in your browser.
